markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Conformal set holds Normal only, and all five similar cases agree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 100%, others 0% | Overwhelmingly Normal |
| Conformal set | {Normal} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / 26th percentile | Typical, trustworthy input |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal [F5] | Unanimous |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 4, 7, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; associated with lower invasive likelihood [F3] · Validated
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Scarce; score below typical, lowering invasive association [F4] · Validated
- **Normal lobules, two-layered epithelium** (regions 2, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Scored high, but failed spot check, 0/20 [F2] · Unreliable
- **Sampled nuclei** (regions 0, 7, 11) · context · Mostly connective; one neoplastic nucleus, no cell features computed · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); it is faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007); not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Tumor is focal and lies outside the three nuclei-sampled regions.
- Calibration rests on 132 test images; the guarantee is dataset-level, not per-case.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 7** — Highest tumor-infiltrating stroma score; holds the only neoplastic nucleus sampled.
2. **Region 11** — Highest per-region invasive risk (1%); verify lobules, since that concept failed its spot check.
3. **Region 5** — Top region for mitoses, TILs, intraductal cells; the mitoses score is unreliable.
